symptom: PC0 cannot reach the default gateway
expected_fault: Router1 GigabitEthernet0/0 is administratively down
ai_root_cause: Router1 GigabitEthernet0/0 is administratively down
recommendation: Check the router interface status and enable GigabitEthernet0/0 if it is administratively down.

symptom: PC0 cannot communicate with PC1
expected_fault: Incorrect or failed switch port configuration
ai_root_cause: Incorrect or failed switch port configuration
recommendation: Check the switch ports connected to PC0 and PC1 and verify their configuration.

symptom: PC0 has an incorrect default gateway
expected_fault: Incorrect default gateway configured on PC0
ai_root_cause: Incorrect default gateway configured on PC0
recommendation: Verify the PC default gateway and make sure it matches the router interface address.

symptom: PC1 cannot reach router
expected_fault: PC1 has an incorrect IP subnet configuration
ai_root_cause: PC1 has an incorrect IP subnet configuration
recommendation: Check the IP address and subnet mask configured on PC1.

symptom: PC0 receives destination unreachable
expected_fault: PC0 is configured in the wrong subnet
ai_root_cause: PC0 is configured in the wrong subnet
recommendation: Check connectivity between PC0, the switch and Router1.

symptom: VLAN 10 PC cannot communicate with VLAN 20 PC
expected_fault: Inter-VLAN routing configuration missing
ai_root_cause: Inter-VLAN routing configuration missing
recommendation: Check VLAN configuration and verify that inter-VLAN routing is configured.

symptom: PC in VLAN 10 cannot access another VLAN
expected_fault: VLAN 20 router subinterface is down
ai_root_cause: VLAN 20 router subinterface is down
recommendation: Verify VLAN membership and switch port configuration.

symptom: VLAN 20 device has no connectivity
expected_fault: Access port assigned to wrong VLAN
ai_root_cause: Access port assigned to wrong VLAN
recommendation: Check whether the VLAN exists and whether the required ports belong to it.

symptom: Trunk link is not carrying VLAN traffic
expected_fault: Switch-to-switch/router link configured as access port
ai_root_cause: Switch-to-switch/router link configured as access port
recommendation: Check the trunk configuration and verify that the required VLANs are allowed.

symptom: Inter-VLAN ping fails despite correct IP addresses
expected_fault: Required VLAN not allowed on trunk
ai_root_cause: Required VLAN not allowed on trunk
recommendation: Verify router subinterfaces, VLAN IDs and trunk configuration.

symptom: PC does not receive an IP address
expected_fault: DHCP service or pool is unavailable
ai_root_cause: DHCP service or pool is unavailable
recommendation: Check the DHCP configuration and verify that the client is connected correctly.

symptom: PC receives an address from the wrong network
expected_fault: DHCP pool has incorrect network configuration
ai_root_cause: DHCP pool has incorrect network configuration
recommendation: Verify the DHCP pool and network configuration.

symptom: PC receives an incorrect default gateway
expected_fault: Incorrect default-router option in DHCP pool
ai_root_cause: Incorrect default-router option in DHCP pool
recommendation: Check the DHCP pool network and default gateway settings.

symptom: DHCP clients cannot obtain addresses
expected_fault: DHCP pool is missing or incorrectly configured
ai_root_cause: DHCP pool is missing or incorrectly configured
recommendation: Verify DHCP pool availability and configuration.

symptom: IP connectivity works but domain name does not resolve
expected_fault: Incorrect DNS server configured on client
ai_root_cause: Incorrect DNS server configured on client
recommendation: Check DNS configuration and test connectivity to the DNS server.

symptom: Client cannot resolve server name
expected_fault: Client points to incorrect DNS server
ai_root_cause: Client points to incorrect DNS server
recommendation: Verify the DNS server address and DNS service configuration.

symptom: DNS server is unreachable
expected_fault: DNS server is in an unreachable subnet
ai_root_cause: DNS server is in an unreachable subnet
recommendation: Check connectivity between the client and DNS server.

symptom: DHCP client receives IP but cannot resolve hostnames
expected_fault: Incorrect DNS server address supplied by DHCP
ai_root_cause: Incorrect DNS server address supplied by DHCP
recommendation: Verify the DHCP-assigned IP configuration and gateway.

symptom: Remote network cannot be reached
expected_fault: Missing route to remote network
ai_root_cause: Missing route to remote network
recommendation: Check the routing table and verify a route exists to the remote network.

symptom: Router has route but traffic still fails
expected_fault: Incorrect next-hop address in static route
ai_root_cause: Incorrect next-hop address in static route
recommendation: Verify the routing configuration and next-hop information.

symptom: Two routers cannot communicate
expected_fault: Router interface toward remote network is shutdown
ai_root_cause: Router interface toward remote network is shutdown
recommendation: Check the connection and IP configuration between the routers.

symptom: Remote network is unreachable after topology change
expected_fault: Required static route was removed
ai_root_cause: Required static route was removed
recommendation: Verify routes after the topology change.

symptom: Traffic is blocked even though routing is correct
expected_fault: ACL denies traffic from source network
ai_root_cause: ACL denies traffic from source network
recommendation: Check ACL rules that may be blocking the traffic.

symptom: PC cannot access server but other traffic works
expected_fault: ACL blocks HTTP traffic
ai_root_cause: ACL blocks HTTP traffic
recommendation: Review the ACL and verify whether the required server traffic is permitted.

symptom: All traffic from a subnet is blocked
expected_fault: ACL contains an incorrect deny statement
ai_root_cause: ACL contains an incorrect deny statement
recommendation: Check the ACL for a subnet-wide deny rule.

symptom: ACL appears correct but traffic is still blocked
expected_fault: ACL applied in the wrong direction/interface
ai_root_cause: ACL applied in the wrong direction/interface
recommendation: Verify ACL direction, interface and rule ordering.

symptom: Internal PC cannot access external network
expected_fault: NAT configuration is missing or inactive
ai_root_cause: NAT configuration is missing or inactive
recommendation: Check NAT configuration and translation rules.

symptom: Private IP is not translated to public IP
expected_fault: NAT inside/outside interface configuration is incorrect
ai_root_cause: NAT inside/outside interface configuration is incorrect
recommendation: Verify NAT inside/outside interfaces and translation rules.

symptom: Only some internal hosts can access outside network
expected_fault: NAT access list does not include all internal hosts
ai_root_cause: NAT access list does not include all internal hosts
recommendation: Check NAT configuration and the internal/external network settings.

symptom: Wireless client cannot obtain network connectivity
expected_fault: Wireless client is not properly associated with the access point
ai_root_cause: Wireless client is not properly associated with the access point
recommendation: Check the wireless configuration, SSID and client network settings.
